overview_description.description:
Ring is an outdoor home security company that provides homeowners a line of preventative outdoor security doorbells and cameras. It is on a mission to reduce crime in neighborhoods and empower consumers by creating a Ring of Security around homes and communities with its suite of smart home security products: Ring Video Doorbell, Ring Video Doorbell Pro, Ring Stick Up Cam, and the new Ring Floodlight Cam. With these security devices, Ring has created the neighborhood watch for the digital age and continues to prevent burglaries and keep homes around the world safe.

The company was established in 2012 and is based in Santa Monica, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Ring is an outdoor home security that provides homeowners a line of preventative security doorbells and cameras.

product.name: Ring Video Doorbells
product.description: Connected doorbells that provide video, motion alerts, two-way communication, and remote visitor access through the Ring app. Models include wired, battery-powered, peephole, and Pro variants.

product.name: Ring Security Cameras
product.description: Indoor and outdoor cameras for live viewing, motion detection, video alerts, and property monitoring. The range includes indoor, outdoor, spotlight, floodlight, pan-tilt, solar, and multi-camera systems.

product.name: Ring Alarm
product.description: A modular home alarm system using a base station, keypad, sensors, and related devices to detect intrusion and other household emergencies.

product.name: Ring Protect Plans
product.description: Subscription plans that add cloud video recording, smart alerts, device management, intelligent recognition, extended warranties, and emergency monitoring to compatible Ring devices.

product.name: Ring Virtual Security Guard
product.description: A subscription service that combines Ring’s intelligent security features with live video monitoring and real-time intruder deterrence by trained security professionals.

product.name: Ring Mobile Security Tower
product.description: A mobile, solar-powered security tower with a camera mast for temporary or remote monitoring of jobsites, commercial properties, parking areas, and other locations.
